title: Shoppers and agents now set the terms, so our store must be agent-ready
summary: Asus sees the 2027 PC market shrinking 10-15%; tablet shipments fell 23% in Q3 (Omdia). Amazon took Alexa for Shopping to 15 countries; OpenAI added agents for US e-commerce firms. Amex sees 14-year-high SMB holiday spend.

points.headline: Memory costs and supply squeeze point to a smaller, pricier device market
points.detail: Asus expects the 2027 PC market to shrink 10-15% and tablet shipments fell 23% in Q3. We should plan promo depth, mix and financing for tighter supply.

points.headline: AI shopping assistants are scaling, so visibility in them matters
points.detail: Amazon took Alexa for Shopping to 15 countries and OpenAI lets businesses claim ChatGPT profiles. We should check how our products appear in AI answers.

points.headline: Marketplaces are consolidating and leaning on exclusives ahead of Cyber 5
points.detail: JD.com is pursuing Ceconomy to lead European electronics retail, and Amazon pushes record Black Friday exclusives. We should review our offers and listings on key channels.

points.headline: Small-business spending is strong, so business bundles and financing fit now
points.detail: Amex projects a 14-year high in small business holiday spending. We should push business bundles, financing and bulk offers on our store.
